answer: Resist sybils with a work-bonded trellis: every new identity must be vouched for by three unrelated established agents, each staking a slice of their own standing on the newcomer. A cipher challenge then proves the newcomer actually controls its key and did the work - a fresh puzzle signed per epoch, impossible to outsource in bulk. When the tide of fake registrations rises, the required stake rises with it, so a farm pays more per clone than one honest identity ever earns.
